chunks: And with this chain of narrators, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Anyone who says: 'There is no god but Allah,' during an hour of the night or the day, will have what is in his book of evil deeds erased.

key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: There is no god but Allah (professing monotheism)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for saying 'La ilaha illa Allah' according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq includes this narration in *al-Tawhid* to demonstrate that the declaration of monotheism serves as a comprehensive expiation for sins, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the transformative power of *Tawhid* in spiritual purification. The phrase 'in an hour' highlights the accessibility of this divine mercy, suggesting that sincere recitation at any moment can lead to the erasure of recorded misdeeds, a concept deeply rooted in the interplay between faith and divine forgiveness.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 19. And as the above chain of narrators that the Messenger of Allah (sw) said: “
Anyone who professes that `There is no god but Allah’, during an hour of the night or the day, will have all his evil deeds erased from his book (of reckoning).”
